name: consensus
description: Consensus create, decide, plan, refine, evaluate, review, panel, phone-a-friend, delegate, observer, and observer-collab skills for deliberation, bounded review, consultation, task delegation, and observation.

interface.shortDescription: Create, decide, plan, refine, evaluate, review, consult peers, delegate tasks, or observe sessions with Consensus.
interface.longDescription: Consensus skills for creating artifacts from briefs, deciding between options, planning from goals and constraints, refining and evaluating artifacts with multiple AI peers, running one bounded independent review, running attributed panels, asking one peer for advice, handing one task to another provider for the host to verify, and observing coding-agent sessions with optional collaboration control.
defaultPrompt: Use Consensus Create, Decide, Plan, Refine, or Evaluate to draft, choose, plan, improve, or judge an artifact with AI peers.
Use Consensus Review for a bounded review, Panel or Phone-a-friend for peer advice, or Delegate to hand a task to another model.
Use Consensus Observer to inspect session progress, or Observer-collab when coordinated control is explicitly needed.
